create_logger_with_file_and_console_hand: create a logger that writes debug logs to a file and info logs to the console
create_log_formatter_with_elapsed_time: create a LogFormatter class that formats log records with level name, timestamp, and elapsed time
reset_logger_elapsed_time: reset the logger elapsed time by calling the reset_time method attached to the logger
log_args_as_info_message: log all argparse arguments as an info message when creating the logger
format_multiline_log_messages: format multiline log messages by indenting continuation lines to align with the log prefix
